import pytest
from backend.models.enums import OrderStatus


def test_create_order(client):
    payload = {"user_id": "user_001", "total_amount": 99.9, "items": []}
    res = client.post("/orders", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data["user_id"] == "user_001"
    assert data["total_amount"] == 99.9
    assert data["items"] == []
    assert data["status"] == OrderStatus.PENDING.value
    assert isinstance(data["id"], int)


def test_list_orders(client):
    client.post("/orders", json={"user_id": "u1", "total_amount": 10.0, "items": []})
    res = client.get("/orders")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) > 0


def test_get_single_order(client):
    res = client.post("/orders", json={"user_id": "u2", "total_amount": 20.0, "items": []})
    order_id = res.json()["id"]
    res = client.get(f"/orders/{order_id}")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["id"] == order_id


def test_update_order_status(client):
    res = client.post("/orders", json={"user_id": "u3", "total_amount": 30.0, "items": []})
    order_id = res.json()["id"]
    res = client.put(f"/orders/{order_id}/status", json={"new_status": "confirmed"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "confirmed"


def test_delete_order(client):
    res = client.post("/orders", json={"user_id": "u4", "total_amount": 40.0, "items": []})
    order_id = res.json()["id"]
    res = client.delete(f"/orders/{order_id}")
    assert res.status_code == 204
    res = client.get(f"/orders/{order_id}")
    assert res.status_code == 404


def test_invalid_status_transition(client):
    res = client.post("/orders", json={"user_id": "u5", "total_amount": 50.0, "items": []})
    order_id = res.json()["id"]
    client.put(f"/orders/{order_id}/status", json={"new_status": "confirmed"})
    client.put(f"/orders/{order_id}/status", json={"new_status": "shipped"})
    client.put(f"/orders/{order_id}/status", json={"new_status": "delivered"})
    res = client.put(f"/orders/{order_id}/status", json={"new_status": "pending"})
    assert res.status_code == 422

### doc
# ShopFlow API

## Overview
RESTful order management service built with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic v2. Implements a strict state machine for order lifecycle transitions.

## Endpoints
| Method | Path                  | Description                  | Status Codes         |
|--------|-----------------------|------------------------------|----------------------|
| POST   | `/orders`             | Create new order             | 201 Created          |
| GET    | `/orders`             | List all orders              | 200 OK               |
| GET    | `/orders/{id}`        | Get order details            | 200 OK / 404 Not Found|
| PUT    | `/orders/{id}/status` | Transition order status      | 200 OK / 422 Invalid |
| DELETE | `/orders/{id}`        | Remove order                 | 204 No Content       |

## State Machine
`pending` → `confirmed` / `cancelled`  
`confirmed` → `shipped` / `cancelled`  
`shipped` → `delivered` / `cancelled`  
`delivered` / `cancelled` → terminal states

## Configuration
- Database: SQLite (`./backend/shopflow.db`)
- CORS: Enabled for all origins (development mode)
- Timezone: UTC enforced via `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`

## Testing
In-memory SQLite isolation via `StaticPool`. Run with:
pytest tests/ -v

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from backend.database import engine, Base
from backend.routers.orders import router as orders_router


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """Application startup and shutdown lifecycle."""
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    yield


app = FastAPI(title="ShopFlow API", lifespan=lifespan)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(orders_router)


@app.get("/", tags=["Root"])
def read_root():
    """Health check endpoint."""
    return {"message": "ShopFlow API is running"}

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, List
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, DateTime, JSON
from backend.database import Base
from backend.models.enums import OrderStatus


class Order(Base):
    """ORM representation of an order entity."""
    __tablename__ = "orders"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(String, nullable=False, index=True)
    status = Column(String, default=OrderStatus.PENDING.value, nullable=False)
    total_amount = Column(Float, default=0.0, nullable=False)
    items = Column(JSON, default=list, nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), nullable=False)

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<Order(id={self.id}, status={self.status})>"
